label: Anthropic's cloud
gloss: A cloud container on a fresh clone: Claude Code on the web, and Cowork on web and mobile.
reaches: a clone of each repository the session was started with, connectors, an allowlisted network, headless Chromium; none of your files

label: OpenAI's cloud
gloss: Codex cloud tasks, in a container on a clone of a connected repo; unused here.
reaches: a clone of a connected repo; none of your files

label: Home laptop
gloss: The home laptop, as the signed-in user: Claude Code, Cowork, Antigravity, the Codex app and the laptop daemon run here.
reaches: the laptop as you: files, apps, browser, and fetched clones of the estate's repos under ~/gh

label: Work machine
gloss: Your work computer, under work's rules; no agent runs there.
reaches: work files, under work's rules; code arrives by copy-paste from GitHub or the Web Tools app

label: GitHub's runners
gloss: GitHub-hosted runners, which GitHub Actions workflows run on.
reaches: open egress, CPU only, no local files

label: Your phone
gloss: Your iPhone: Shortcuts writing through Log-Repo, and pages opened from a link.
reaches: what the GitHub token stored on the device reaches
